source_spans.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the definitional rule that any name change not defined as immaterial under 8 FAM 403.1-5 constitutes a material discrepancy.

source_spans.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately represents the requirement that applicants must explain material discrepancies between their application name, citizenship/nationality evidence, and identity evidence.

source_spans.quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately states the requirement that evidence of material name changes must be checked for counterfeiting or alteration.

source_spans.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name following a material name change, as well as the qualification regarding specific permission in the documentation.

source_spans.quote: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim models the exception to C0003 where name change documentation explicitly permits continuing to use the prior name.

source_spans.quote: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim preserves the tentative modality ('might be required') and accurately states the condition under 22 CFR 51.23(c).

source_spans.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the mandatory action to suspend the DS-11 application and request updated ID when a material name change occurred more than one year before without an updated ID.

source_spans.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim captures the permission to issue a limited-validity passport when there is insufficient time before urgent or emergency travel to request updated ID.

source_spans.quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim preserves the general practical observation that the applicant will usually require name change documents to update their ID.

source_spans.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim correctly details the mandatory notation procedure ('seen and returned') prior to returning documentation with an IRL.

source_spans.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the exemption from submitting new ID for applicants whose material name change occurred within one year of applying on Form DS-11.

source_spans.quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the requirement that applicants whose material name change occurred within one year must submit name change documentation if their ID has not yet been changed.
